summary: Implemented prepareUpdate and the Update container as specified. Changes: Update class added to rdflib/plugins/sparql/sparql.py; translateUpdate in algebra.py now always returns an Update, building the prologue from q.prologue[0] before the empty-request early exit; evalUpdate in update.py iterates update.algebra; prepareUpdate added to processor.py and exported from rdflib/plugins/sparql/__init__.py; new test module test/test_sparql_prepare.py added. Nothing was run and nothing was committed, so tests and black formatting are unverified. Known leftover: pprintAlgebra on the DAWG debug path prints the algebra list rather than pretty-printing it, but does not crash.
